value.title: C34 amended: one reviewer, one round per PR

sections.name: body
sections.value:
C34 as amended by Jordan on 2026-11-22 (RULINGS 1b03b46e) supersedes the 'max 2 rounds, reviewer+security+performance' practice.
- ONE reviewer, ONE round per PR. The reviewer covers correctness, cost (AGENTS.md resource rules) and security, including privacy: no account names, emails or machine paths.
- The author fixes the findings. pm-001 sends READY with a map from each finding to its fix commit. The prime range-diffs those commits and merges. No round 2, no second reviewer.
- A PR is held only for a real normal-use bug (wrong result, data loss, a stalled seat, a cost breach). Everything else becomes a follow-up, and under C35 new follow-ups need Jordan's yes.
- Pick the one reviewer on Claude when security matters (the old rule was security always on Claude). Spawn it fresh per PR and close it after the round.
- After-deploy cost readings (pij-rs --json ping .data.spawns twice, a known interval apart; just spawn-rate --seconds 20) can be taken read-only by pm-001 itself; no performance seat is needed.
